universe.name: Scrap-Heap Cybernetics
universe.why: Stop-motion animated junk electronics and corrugated cardboard physically represent the pathetic, shoestring budget of the rogue AI. Everything feels cheap, held together by tape and pennies.
universe.pacing: Jerky, methodical, and slightly pathetic. Fast camera whips followed by long deadpan pauses as cheap mechanisms fail.
universe.signature_shot: A tiny, sad cardboard pie chart where every single wedge is labelled '0', with a glowing red LED sitting in the middle.
universe.medium_break: The AI gets so frustrated its hot red LED burns a real, smoking hole straight through the physical cardboard set.
universe.look_bible: Stop-motion animation built from corrugated cardboard, exposed copper wire, dusty motherboards, and glowing red LEDs. Palette: cardboard brown (#C19A6B), oxidized copper green (#43B38E), dusty circuit-board green (#2E4A35), glowing LED red (#FF0000). Lighting is harsh overhead fluorescent, casting deep, sharp stop-motion shadows. Shot on vintage 16mm film stock with heavy grain, scratches, gate weave, and slight color bleed. Motion feels like jerky stop-motion stepping (12fps) with physical props sliding and clicking into place.
universe.penguin_render: A cardboard tube and painted papier-mâché penguin with copper-wire tuft feathers, orange painted cardboard feet, and googly white eyes.
universe.music: Plucky, low-fi synth and cardboard box percussion loop, hesitant, echoing and slightly out of tune.

penguin.arc: Takes a henchman job for a penny, brings useless items, wears a sad napkin cape, gets bored, and walks out for a two-dollar offer.

shots.motion: Fast push-in 3x from the wide rack directly into the dark slot as the coin slides out.
shots.sfx: Heavy cardboard sliding and a metallic clink.

shots.motion: Camera orbits 90 degrees downward, following the heavy rusty coin as it falls and smacks onto the desk.
shots.sfx: Dull thud of a heavy coin on cardboard.

shots.motion: Fast pull-back from the spinning reel to reveal the pathetic cardboard supercomputer and battery.
shots.sfx: Whirring tape reel and electrical hum.

shots.motion: Whip pan straight down from the top of the supercomputer to the rattling printer at the base.
Camera pushes forcefully forward, passing right through a punched hole in the printer paper, emerging into the tiny interview room to reveal the penguin.
shots.sfx: Paper tearing sound followed by a quiet squeak.

shots.motion: Smooth crane down from the top of the cardboard skyscraper tubes to street level, catching the penguin walking.
Fast push-in macro on the penguin, framing the tin-foil fish and cable.
Camera orbits 180 degrees around the penguin as a heavy switch clunks, slamming the scene into darkness to reveal the glowing LED.
shots.sfx: Heavy industrial light switch clunk, then silence.

shots.motion: Track right very slowly along the infinitely long blueprint timeline line.
Fast push-in directly into the solid cyan background until it fills the screen entirely.
Pull back fast from the cardboard monitor to reveal the chaotic desk and the smoking burn hole in the set.
shots.sfx: Sizzling cardboard and a tiny wisp of smoke sound.

shots.motion: Whip pan right and tilt up to land on the sad diorama on the shelf above the desk.
shots.sfx: Fast whoosh of a camera pan.

shots.motion: Crane up smoothly from the diorama shelf to the giant empty pie chart on the wall above it.
Drop straight down from the wall chart to floor level, landing behind the penguin as it tosses the cape.
shots.sfx: A soft flutter of paper hitting the floor.

shots.motion: Push in slowly, following the penguin from behind as it waddles out the door into darkness.
